newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Horse Racing-Owner turns down bid for Doran's Prid.
newsitem.headline: Horse Racing-Owner turns down bid for Doran's Prid.

text.p: Owner Tom Doran said on Tuesday he had turned down a 300,000 Irish pounds offer from an English-based consortium for Ireland's top chaser, Doran's Pride.
The same consortium made a 250,000 Irish pounds offer for Doran's Pride after the gelding beat Paul Nicholls-trained See More Business to win the Drinmore Novice Chase at Fairyhouse on December 1.

Although Doran's Pride is expected to be entered for the Cheltenham Gold Cup in 1997, trainer Michael Hourigan has hinted he may go for the Stayers' Hurdle, a race his stable star won in 1995, instead.
